title: Tomato Chicken Skewers
description: In this easy tomato chicken skewers recipe, cherry tomatoes and cubed chicken are smothered in a sweet and savory sauce, placed on skewers, and broiled .
ingredients: 1.25 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps.text: Soak 8 wooden skewers in a bowl of cold water for 30 minutes to prevent burning during cooking.
Combine tomato paste, honey, Worcestershire sauce, and chopped rosemary in a large glass or ceramic bowl. Add chicken pieces to glaze; stir to coat.
Set an oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler to medium heat.
Alternately thread chicken pieces and cherry tomatoes onto skewers; place on a broiler pan. Spoon remaining glaze over skewers.

Cook under the preheated broiler, flipping occasionally, until chicken is no longer pink in centers and the juices run clear, 8 to 10 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into centers should read 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
Transfer to a serving plate; garnish with rosemary sprigs.
